primitives.note: Mortal Will: stacks 0-5 gained per landed basic attack on-hit or ability cast; at 5 stacks the next basic ability (Q/W/E) consumes them to become empowered.
Q charges up to 4s (auto-releasing at max, or on recast), gaining range; releasing within 0.35s instead casts an immediate thrust.
Q's charge resolves via a recast (thrust if quick-released, hurl if held past 0.35s); cooldown starts post-effect, not on initial cast.
Quick-release (tap) thrust refunds 60% of Comet Spear's cooldown.
Comet Spear's damage is substantially increased against targets below 20% of their maximum health.
Mana costs (25/55/80/100) and Pantheon's base mana pool can limit how many casts fit in a 15s window.
Shield Vault's damage is a percent of the target's maximum health (plus flat AP/bonus-HP scaling).
Mortal Will empowers Pantheon's next basic attack (within 4s) to strike the target 3 times for AD-scaling damage instead of a normal attack.
The empowered 3-hit attack resets Pantheon's basic attack timer upon completion.
The empowered attack rolls a single crit check that applies uniformly to all 3 strikes (all crit or none do).
Aegis Assault channels for 1.5s (uninterruptible by CC), dealing continual tick damage, and cannot be interrupted mid-channel.
E's channel deals repeated cone strikes, capped at a total of 100% AD physical damage over the channel.
E's channel ticks and its recast slam are separately-timed damage instances (recast available after 0.3s, or automatic at 1.5s).
Mortal Will bonus on E recast grants bonus armor and magic resist (scaling with bonus HP) for 4s, plus movement speed for 1.5s.
Grand Starfall runs a 2s channel then a further 2.25s channel (CC-immune, vanished) before dealing its damage and landing.
R deals a physical spear hit partway through the channel and a separate magic shockwave hit later, at different (estimated) timings within the same cast.

needsBespoke.why: Every damage-relevant mechanic (Mortal Will stacking/consumption, Q's charge-tap-vs-hold split with execute scaling and CDR refund, W's percent-health vault plus empowered 3-hit attack with attack-reset and single crit roll, E's channel DoT plus separate recast slam and post-recast resist buff, R's two-stage channel with a spear hit then a shockwave hit) maps onto existing primitives (stacking-self-buff, charge-or-channel, recast-or-multipart, cooldown-manipulation, execute-or-threshold, conditional-damage, empowered-attack, attack-reset, crit-interaction, dot, timed-self-buff, resource-budget).

proposal: Assume Pantheon starts the fight with 5 Mortal Will stacks (guaranteed at game start/after recall/respawn).
Open by casting Q with a quick release (under 0.35s) so it both consumes the Mortal Will empowerment for bonus physical damage and refunds 60% of its cooldown.
Cast W (Shield Vault) to land its percent-max-health damage on the dummy.
Cast E (Aegis Assault), holding the full 1.5s channel to maximize the capped 100% AD tick damage, then let it auto-recast (or recast immediately after 0.3s) for the slam damage.
Weave in basic attacks whenever no ability is off cooldown, both for direct damage and to regenerate Mortal Will stacks for the next Q/E cast.
Recast Q on cooldown, always with a quick tap release to keep chaining the CDR refund and maximize cast frequency over the 15s window.

Fire R (Grand Starfall) once, if it is assumed available (its ~150-180s cooldown normally rules it out of a single 15s window unless the simulator seeds it as ready), targeting the dummy for the spear hit and the shockwave.

Continue alternating Q (tap) and basic attacks/E-channel for the remainder of the 15s, prioritizing whichever ability is off cooldown, since Q's low cooldown and CDR refund make it the primary DPS loop.
questions: Should Mortal Will stacks always be spent into Q for maximum single-target damage, or does spending them into W's 3-hit empowered attack ever out-DPS that at the levels/items being simulated?
Is Grand Starfall (R) assumed available at the start of the 15s damage fight, or excluded entirely given its long cooldown relative to the fight length?
Should E's channel always be held the full 1.5s to maximize DoT total, or is it better to recast at the 0.3s minimum to fit more E casts (and more Mortal Will generation) into 15s?
During Q's charge, is holding for the full 4s (bigger single hit, but longer downtime and a self-slow) ever preferable to the quick tap-and-refund loop for maximizing 15s damage?
Does the empowered W 3-hit attack pause Pantheon's other actions (Q/E casts) for its full locked-out duration, and should the rotation avoid triggering it mid-loop if it stalls higher-DPS abilities?
